title: One indexed replacement has an exact quadratic remainder
source_anchor: Samplinglib original quadratic feature-risk supplement v1, interface4
target_statement: Let H be any real inner-product normed space, N>0, a:Fin N->H, i:Fin N, and u,y in H. Let b be any real number and assume ||a_i||<=b and ||u||<=b. Define m=N^{-1} sum_j a_j and mNew=N^{-1} sum_j Function.update(a,i,u)_j. Then ||mNew-y||²-||m-y||²-2 inner(m-y,mNew-m)=||mNew-m||², and this squared remainder is at most4b²/N². The mean displacement is derived, not assumed. No bound on y or the other features, completeness, or measure hypothesis is needed.
